exact_missing_identification.missing_cocycle_identification: either compute psi_z directly from the selected homoclinic orbit, or certify J_{z_*,p} and an equality/error bound between psi_z and J_{z_*,p} L J_{z_*,p}^-1
exact_missing_identification.missing_orbit_record: one selected bi-infinite p-tail/excursion/p-tail physical orbit z with immutable regular itinerary and local-plaque entry times
exact_missing_identification.missing_twisting_test: four nonzero wedges between the QNL Perron lines and psi_z on E_p
exact_missing_identification.only_typed_shadow_comparison: compare psi_z:E_p->E_p with J_{z_*,p} L J_{z_*,p}^-1:E_p->E_p
exact_missing_identification.periodic_shadow_basepoint: z_* is periodic and is not QNL-homoclinic
exact_missing_identification.required_cross_fiber_transport: a certified gauge-covariant J_{z_*,p}:E_{z_*}->E_p, if the periodic shadow is to be compared with a QNL loop
exact_missing_identification.required_loop_fiber: psi_z acts on E_p for a genuine QNL-homoclinic z

finite_word_gauge_propagation.base_maps_and_cocycles: T is the one-collision billiard map with cocycle C; the QNL has full-collision period two, F=T^2 fixes the selected phase p, and A(x)=C^2(x) is the F-cocycle
finite_word_gauge_propagation.closed_96_collision_shadow_conjugacy: T^96 z_*=z_* gives L_hat(z_*)=B_hat(z_*)^-1 L(z_*) B_hat(z_*); this remains an endomorphism of E_{z_*}
finite_word_gauge_propagation.closed_word_conjugacy: if T^m z=z (equivalently for an F-word when m is even), then L_hat(z)=B_hat(z)^-1 L(z) B_hat(z)
finite_word_gauge_propagation.collision_section_extension: use B_hat on the selected QNL collision component and the identity on every other disjoint obstacle component
finite_word_gauge_propagation.concatenation_compatibility: at every T- or F-word concatenation endpoint y, the adjacent B_hat(y) B_hat(y)^-1 factors cancel exactly
finite_word_gauge_propagation.finite_collision_word_telescope: C_hat^m(x)=B_hat(T^m x)^-1 C^m(x) B_hat(x) for every finite regular m-collision word
finite_word_gauge_propagation.finite_return_word_telescope: A_hat^n(x)=B_hat(F^n x)^-1 A^n(x) B_hat(x) for every finite regular n-return word
finite_word_gauge_propagation.intrinsic_section_gauge: B_hat is the compact QNL-chart formula on U_chart and the identity on its boundary collar and outside U_chart; chart representatives are related by ordinary tangent-coordinate conjugacy
finite_word_gauge_propagation.one_collision_gauge_cocycle: C_hat(x)=B_hat(Tx)^-1 C(x) B_hat(x), matching the frozen resonant-gauge convention

homoclinic_tail_extension.clean_basic_set_phase_alignment: the cyclic F=T^2 component of the nontrivial clean T-basic set containing p has local product structure and supplies clean z in W^s_F(p) intersect W^u_F(p) outside the QNL orbit
homoclinic_tail_extension.phase_aligned_return: F=T^2, p is the selected fixed QNL phase, and A_hat^(k)(x):E_x->E_{F^k x} for every signed regular integer k
homoclinic_tail_extension.stable_extension_formula: if z_N=F^N z is in W^s_loc(p), then H^s_{p,z}=A_hat^(N)(z)^-1 H^s_{p,z_N} A_hat^(N)(p):E_p->E_z
homoclinic_tail_extension.typed_endomorphism: for every such phase-aligned z, psi_z=H^s_{z,p} o H^u_{p,z}:E_p->E_p is well-defined in the compact-gauge cocycle
homoclinic_tail_extension.unstable_extension_formula: if z_-N=F^-N z is in W^u_loc(p), then H^u_{p,z}=A_hat^(-N)(z)^-1 H^u_{p,z_-N} A_hat^(-N)(p):E_p->E_z

strict_frontier.negative: no selected homoclinic orbit or gauge-covariant identification of its holonomy loop with the finite-shadow matrix L
strict_frontier.positive: finite QNL/connector return-word gauges telescope without an overlap seam; local QNL holonomies extend along finite tails, so an existential clean homoclinic point has a typed endomorphism
